description: Implementation of the WindowSurfaceWGL class for managing WGL window surfaces in OpenGL on Windows, including pixel format setup, buffer swapping, and surface properties.

classes.name: rx::WindowSurfaceWGL
classes.description: WGL implementation of egl::Surface for Windows, handling surface creation, pixel format configuration, buffer swapping, and surface properties.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window surface, sets pixel format, and queries swap behavior.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers for the surface.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Unimplemented method for posting a sub-region of the buffer.

methods.name: querySurfacePointerANGLE
methods.description: Returns nullptr for surface pointer queries.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Unimplemented method for binding a texture image.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Unimplemented method for releasing a texture image.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval if supported.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the window surface.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the window surface.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Indicates whether post sub-buffer is supported (not on WGL).

methods.name: getSwapBehavior
methods.description: Returns the swap behavior of the surface.
